additional_info.body:
During commissiong the touch screen of the black panel was not working.
checks on site :
- reboot of charger
- powering off and then on the black panel
- changing the USB cable
- Benjamin from R&D joined to check it from his side => but the touch of the screen still not working => it seems a HW issue => we will proceed with the replacement

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0389993-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/R9 313202799073] Touch screen not working CRM:01811000452
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I am reaching out to inform you of an issue encountered during the commissioning of the black panel. The touch screen was not functioning properly. Below are the checks are performed on-site:
Rebooting the charger
Powering off and then on the black panel
Changing the USB cable
Additionally, Benjamin from R&D joined to investigate the issue further, but unfortunately, the touch screen remains unresponsive. Based on the tests and his assessment, it appears to be a hardware-related issue.
As a next step, we need proceed with the replacement of the unit.
Could you please prioritize this matter and assist with the necessary steps for the replacement process?
Your prompt attention to this issue would be greatly appreciated.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
